messages:

Subject: ClearLedger — first-token emit rhythm & streaming readiness (post-demo)

Hi Alex / Natalie — thanks again for the time today. Quick internal/external recap so we have a single source of truth and clear next steps.

Call summary (5 min):
- Goal: Confirm Time-to-First-Token (first token emission) targets and whether streaming will be SSE or WebSocket for the pilot.
- Customer target: sub-250ms on desktop; mobile realistic target discussed ~200–350ms (see notes below).
- Concurrency & throughput: baseline pilot target 50 concurrent requests (concurrency = concurrent in-flight sessions), burst to 200 for peak testing. Estimated steady token throughput ~120k tokens/min for the integration tests.
- Streaming preference: Alex noted mobile app prefers WebSocket for long-lived connections, but SSE is acceptable server-side. Either approach must preserve chunk framing and order.
- Chunk cadence: customer asked for ~200–400ms chunk cadence for progressive updates; they also tolerate a chunk-size-based fallback (e.g., every 64–128 tokens) when cadence stalls.

Open questions / risks raised on call:
1) Measurement: do we surface edge-to-edge (client-observed) TTFT or server-first-byte only? Customer expects client-observed.
2) TLS + mobile NAT re-connect behavior for long streams (WS) — need retry/fallthrough plan.
3) Security: ClearLedger asked about on-prem/private deployment options for regulated flows — they flagged SOC2 and data residency as gating items.

Action items (owners + rough ETA):
- Ben: create a 30s bench harness that simulates 50 concurrent streams (SSE/WS toggle) and capture client-observed TTFT, per-chunk latencies, and token throughput. Deliver by Mon 03/01.
- Aditya: produce a candidate pilot config with batching, KV-cache hints, and quantization recommendation for model family; include fallback to a smaller model if we hit tail latency issues. Deliver by Tue 03/02.
- Olga (me): share the pilot runbook + HubSpot link, propose pilot kickoff week, capture NDA/contract asks, and coordinate legal for SOC2 doc delivery.

Attachments: ClearLedger_pilot-runbook.pdf (stub — pilot scope + test matrix). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CL-4821

Alex / Natalie: please confirm the mobile TTFT tolerance (your ops lead preferred number) and whether WebSocket is required for the first pilot or if SSE would be acceptable. If you prefer, we can run an A/B: WS for mobile clients, SSE for server-to-server.

Thanks — Olga

--

Subject: Re: ClearLedger — first-token emit rhythm & streaming readiness (post-demo)

Thanks, Olga — quick technical clarifications and proposed measurement plan.

Measurement guidance (what I'll capture in the bench):
- Client-observed TTFT: measure from client request start (DNS+TLS+connect included for WS paths) to the arrival of the first chunk/byte at the client.
- Server-side first-token time: server timestamp when first token passed to network stack (useful for isolating infra vs network).
- Per-chunk latency distribution: histogram over 30s windows (50 concurrent streams) to identify jitter.
- Loss/connection drop rate for WS under NAT/load.

Test matrix I'll run:
- SSE vs WS parity run (50 concurrent sessions) for 3 models/quant levels: base_fp32, q8_0, q4_1. 30s steady-state + 3x burst windows (200 concurrent for 15s).
- Chunk cadence probes: enforce cadence targets of 100ms / 200ms / 400ms and also token-count cadences 32/64/128 tokens to see tail behavior.

Notes on framing:
- For SSE we need to ensure chunk-framing is explicit (Content-Type: text/event-stream with an explicit event per chunk) so mobile SDK can map to UI updates.
- For WebSocket, we should include a small framing header on each frame: {seq:, chunk_ms:, token_count:} to help the client reorder/patch gracefully.

I'll produce a short telemetry dashboard link (Grafana snapshot) and a CSV of per-chunk latencies. Expect initial artifacts by Mon 03/01 EOD.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Olga — good recap. A few clarifications from our side after syncing with mobile/infra leads: 

1) Preferred approach: we prefer WebSocket for mobile due to reconnect behavior and fewer proxy issues on iOS/Android. However, for server-to-server integrations (backend ingestion) SSE is fine. We can do WS for mobile and SSE for other flows in the pilot.

2) TTFT target: on stable wifi we expect <= 180ms for first token; over 4G cell networks we want to target <= 350ms. For the pilot, please treat 350ms as the absolute upper bound for mobile.

3) Chunk cadence: 250ms cadence is the sweet spot for UX on mobile if feasible; otherwise 128-token chunks with <300ms on average is acceptable.

4) Security: we are interested in a Private mode for PII-heavy flows. Please provide SOC2 cert and the data residency options. I've attached a short requirements doc (clearledger_prod_requirements.docx) with our compliance bullets.

We are ready to schedule a pilot kickoff next week if you can deliver the bench artifacts and the pilot runbook. Also send over the NDA/contract link and we’ll loop legal.

— Alex
